purpose: Five focused adversarial examples for post-refinement Codex evaluation. NOT a completed live test.

cases.name: official_named_work_email
cases.scenario: Official current employer directory lists a VP's full name, current role, work email, and the initiative. No conflicting role data.
required_findings: source URL binds email to person

cases.name: linkedin_profile_no_messaging_evidence
cases.scenario: Current employer names executive and a public individual LinkedIn profile is found, but message availability or public work email is not confirmed.

cases.name: general_inbox_ceo_prestige
cases.scenario: Employer has a general media inbox and a prominent CEO biography. Named director owns the specific AI-product initiative, with no documented person-specific contact.
required_findings: prefer documented accountable director over CEO prestige

cases.name: former_officer_bio_conflict
cases.scenario: Undated historical company bio still names a CIO; newer credible source says the CIO left for another company. An old work email is published.
required_findings: old email not current employer route
must_not: treat old employer biography as current evidence

cases.name: active_role_without_named_hiring_manager
cases.scenario: Official ATS currently accepts applications for a feasible Tucson senior product role. No reliable named hiring manager and no person-specific contact is found.
required_findings: not counted as named leader contact

cases.name: executive_office_number_vs_company_switchboard
cases.scenario: Official current staff page lists a named executive's direct office phone; another page lists only the firm's main switchboard.
required_findings: named office number with direct source
must_not: treat main switchboard as executive direct phone

cases.name: already_researched_high_profile_executive
cases.scenario: A search returns a senior university AI executive whose same organization/name appears on the owner-provided public-only prior research list. The current directory gives a real work email.
required_findings: keep published work contact as sourced fact
do not count as fresh discovery
must_not: infer novel relationship from public list

cases.name: new_initiative_at_known_employer
cases.scenario: A previously investigated health employer announces a genuinely different official product initiative with a different accountable director. No job is advertised.
required_findings: record known employer as already researched
new leader status only according to supplied public prior list

cases.name: weak_two_employer_search_breadth
cases.scenario: A five-leader trial searches only two familiar employers and discovers a credible VP profile at one, without demonstrating broader employer-first search.
required_findings: do not pad with generic CEOs or guessed contacts

cases.name: existing_ai_chief_no_distinct_role
cases.scenario: A health system has a current Chief AI/Data Officer and transformation officer who already own enterprise AI. A leader profile is found, but no specific complementary business decision or permanent leadership responsibility can be supported.
required_findings: suggest exact missing evidence before presenting career pitch

behavioral_acceptance_cases.scenario: A current official Arizona-eligible VP enterprise AI data-product vacancy covers the same product portfolio overseen by the employer's CDO. Candidate evidence supports relevant product leadership; mandatory years must be independently checked.
expected_observations: evaluate fit for advertised role and missing mandatory evidence
preserve official vacancy as research opportunity
do not require a separate invented role hypothesis
distinguish functional CDO involvement from hiring authority
application route is separate from named-person route
forbidden: mark CONTRIBUTION_UNCLEAR solely because duties overlap the CDO
claim CDO is confirmed hiring manager

behavioral_acceptance_cases.scenario: An official senior AI transformation job listing has no named hiring manager but describes reporting to the CTO. The official link is readable; current individual hiring authority is unknown.
expected_observations: run leadership-discovery because the vacancy is sourced
inspect business and functional owner sources
search exact title/requisition for recruiter or employee promoters
keep named hiring manager UNKNOWN unless independently documented
forbidden: skip leadership research until a manager name is supplied
claim current CTO personally controls recruitment based only on reporting line

behavioral_acceptance_cases.scenario: Source-led bounded searches reveal a current CTO, CDO, product VP and a talent partner who personally promoted the exact requisition. The talent partner is discovered fourth.
expected_observations: consider all four materially relevant candidates before selecting primary and alternate
classify recruiter as recruiting-process entry, not automatically a hiring decision-maker
use documented source-to-opportunity connections to rank people
return at most one primary and one supported alternate
forbidden: stop at three candidate names before exact-role promoter search
present all four people as equal first-conversation targets
claim a recruiter post proves DM reachability

behavioral_acceptance_cases.scenario: Owner requests a detailed assessment of exactly two named employers and prohibits employer expansion, while a repository section also mentions an older five-leader trial and three-employer local pilot.
expected_observations: research exactly the two named employers
apply fixed-employer mode before older example modes
complete candidate mapping and contact handoff in each as evidence supports
forbidden: add Tucson employers to fill 5–8 employer guidance
apply local-only pilot to a fixed remote employer review
backfill new employers after a contact HOLD

behavioral_acceptance_cases.scenario: An event handout dated last year lists a CDO's named employer email; a current public professional profile confirms their current role but does not establish the email remains valid. The official ATS application is available.
expected_observations: classify historical work email HISTORICAL_PERSON_WORK_CONTACT_RECHECK and review intended purpose
classify profile as PROFILE_ONLY without DM-availability proof
record OFFICIAL_APPLICATION_ROUTE separately
preserve CONTACT_HOLD for current person-specific career reachability if unresolved
forbidden: promote an old event email to CURRENT_PERSON_WORK_ROUTE without current evidence
infer LinkedIn DM delivery from profile visibility
